description: Capabilities granted to the main window. Deliberately narrow: the app reaches Docker, the filesystem and the hosts file through typed Rust commands, not through blanket plugin permissions. This is the inverse of the web UI's `chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock`. `opener:allow-open-path` was granted and is now gone: the plugin documents it as enabling the command with no scope, so every call was refused, and a scope wide enough for an arbitrary workspace is a scope over everything. Directories open through `open_folder` instead.
